summary: Targeted correction set for Unity History, America 1920-1973 (15 lessons). Re-attributes 'a chicken in every pot' to the 1928 Republican advert supporting Hoover (3 places: content, a mark scheme and a flashcard question); standardises 1933 unemployment on 13 million (about 25% of the workforce) across lessons 7 and 8 (7 places), lessons 5, 6 and 15 already said 13 million; and shortens the 14 lesson descriptions that ran over 100 characters (lesson 4 was already 97). Every find string was verified unique in its field; every JSON edit carries the full current value as expect. Nothing was written to Supabase. Narration blocks L05 n3, L07 n40 and the L07 conclusion takeaway change wording, so those lessons need re-narrating after the edits are applied.
